idea: AI training workshops for finance teams
buyer: Heads of research and L&D at funds and banks
pain: Staff are using AI badly or not at all
v1: A half-day workshop for one team
channel: Her network plus husband's banking contacts
verdict: Easiest thing in the set to sell and to deliver; the ceiling is the problem.

why.distribution: 50+ reachable across her own network and her husband's; workshops are an easy yes.
why.demand: Training budgets exist and are being spent on exactly this.
why.fmf: Getting sceptical, time-poor professionals to change how they work is her distinctive experience.
why.revenue_structure: One-off bookings with occasional repeats for new cohorts.
why.defensibility: Every consultant and training firm offers AI workshops; there is nothing to own.
why.leverage: Materials are reusable but she must be in the room each time.
why.tailwind: Training spend on AI is at its peak of urgency.
why.ceiling: £4k x 30 workshops = £120k, and 30 delivery days plus selling is most of a part-time year.

ceiling_arithmetic: £4k x 30 workshops = £120k. Each is a delivery day plus preparation, so 30 is near capacity part-time and the number cannot be pushed without raising price or productising.
carries: Fastest possible path to revenue, warmest possible channel, strongest tailwind.
kills: Ceiling and defensibility. Workshops are a commodity and her calendar caps the number.
test: Offer a half-day workshop at £3.5k to three firms.
test_fail: They ask her to do it free as a favour.
